_help: v2 hand and ball points (P6-A6): bodies.<body>.<anim>.<DIR>[frame] = {hands: {L, R: [x, y]}, ball: [x, y, front] or null, ball_floor: [x, y], ball_h}. Art px of a 64 x 96 frame (floor row 88). front 1 = draw the ball over the sprite. null = the ball is free (thrown, slammed) or not in this animation. Mirrored rows: x' = 63 - x, swap L and R. sheets.<sheet> = its body.
